_definitions.variants: per variant and index: curve (mean over the 50 splits, orders or tie-breaks), per-N split SE, its maximum, r(20) and its split SE, and per crossing (.70, .80) the point value, the delta-method split SE and the SD, share reaching and 2.5th / 97.5th percentiles over 2,000 resamples of the per-split values
_definitions.target_subset: the same for the Design A students with a weighting target (at least 20 unrated answers and a matched difficulty-by-strand mix)
_definitions.temporal_no_split_error: temporal-half curves (one deterministic split; no split error)
_definitions.variant names: random = random halves; strand, topic, term = halves by whole category; difficulty = harder versus easier items; w_diff_random / w_diffstrand_random = weighted to the unrated difficulty (difficulty-by-strand) mix; w_null_* = the same weights shuffled within student; balanced_random = difficulty-balanced subset, equal weights
